summary: Tested Sociedades Médicas (consumos from POS sales at sale price, resumen, Excel/PDF exports, admin access fix). Backend: 22/22 pytest passed (12 new + 10 regression CRUD). Used seeded TEST_ data: a sociedad, a product with controla_inventario=false, 2 completed sales and 1 anulada sale in Mar-2019. Results: anulada excluded, values match sale subtotals (Q1,450), filters by producto/sociedad/fecha work, resumen by month works, Excel headers and totals correct, PDF has both sections. Role access: a temporary admin user gets 200 on all endpoints and can open /sociedades from sidebar (Inventario > Sociedades) and by direct URL; usuario gets 403 on the API and is sent to /pacientes in the UI with no menu item; superadmin works. UI: Consumos tab columns Fecha/Producto/Sociedad/Cantidad/Monto, cards show 51 / Q18,810.00, the date and product filters update the table and cards, Excel/PDF downloads work, Resumen and Productos tabs render. One UX bug: on first load the cards are empty (see below).

minor.issue: Month boundaries are compared as UTC strings ('YYYY-MM-01T00:00:00'), but the clinic is in Guatemala (UTC-6). Sales made 18:00-23:59 local time on the last day of a month fall into the next month. The Consumos date filter has the same problem (fecha_fin + T23:59:59 UTC).

ui_bugs.issue: The default tab is 'sociedades', and resumenConsumos and productosSociedad only load when the Consumos or Productos tab is opened. So on first load 'Productos Asignados'=0, 'Total Consumos'=0 and 'Monto Vendido'=Q0.00 until the user clicks Consumos. Confirmed for both admin and superadmin. Fix: fetch consumos and productos on mount, independent of the active tab.

issues: Fecha inicio/fin use the browser's native <input type=date> instead of the shadcn Calendar/Popover
Changing a filter does not reset page to 1, so a narrower filter on page>1 shows an empty table
Tabs, filters and cards lack data-testid (only export and CRUD buttons have them)

action_items: Load the consumos summary and productos list on mount, so the stat cards are not 0 on the default Sociedades tab
Optional: use Guatemala local time (UTC-6) for month and date-range boundaries in _recolectar_consumos_sociedad callers
Optional: reset page to 1 when filters change; add data-testids to tabs, filters and cards
critical_code_review_comments: Sociedades.js is about 1073 lines; split the tabs into components
_recolectar_consumos_sociedad loads up to 50k ventas and paginates in memory. Fine for now; consider an aggregation pipeline with $unwind/$match as volume grows
The Excel/PDF buttons ignore the Consumos tab's producto filter. They only respect sociedad and date range, which matches the spec but may surprise users
'Productos Asignados' counts all es_sociedad products, including those with no sociedad ('Sin asignar')
seed_data_creation: All temporary, created and deleted by id: a TEST_ sociedad, a product, 3 ventas (inserted by the test fixture), and temporary admin users TEST_adm_<tag> and test_adminui. Verified 0 leftovers.
context_for_next_testing_agent: CRUD lives at /api/inventario/sociedades/catalogo. No admin password exists in creds; create a temporary admin via POST /api/users (usernames are lowercased). ventas.numero_venta has a unique index. Run: pytest tests/test_sociedades_consumos_ventas.py -p no:xdist
